svg.title: t-maze-grey-t-thick-black-outline-towers-region-labels-field-of-view
svg.desc: top-down T-shaped corridor filled blue-grey with a thick black outline, dashed horizontal dividers across the stem, small white squares with a dark dot as towers on both sides of the stem, region names to the left (Decision region, Delay, Cue region, Start region), a small white mouse at the start under a grey triangle, a green framed field of view over the stem's lower part with an orange tick frame and a purple box over its start, a black up arrow and the label Start beneath | source: icml25-0135_fig1 (icml25-0135_fig1_p4_mixed.svg) | candidate wave1:t-maze-grey-t-thick-black-outline-towers-region-labels-field-of-view | units: pt at print size | colours as drawn, recolour by role
